Completion evidence for Gerrit 2960 (merged):

- Existing implementation on main already publishes host memory/container RSS off-box via observability.sh and tests prove the publish path (`tests/scripts/test_observability_memory_9ea3.py`).
- Existing Terraform already declares the run-up/missing-signal alarms in `infra/terraform/monitoring_membound.tf`; alarm action/window guards pass (`tests/unit/test_alarm_actions_terraform.py`, `tests/unit/test_alarm_window_tuning.py`).
- This change added `infra/runbooks/gerrit-host-wedged-ssm-lost.md` memory-wedge triage so a future no-SSM outage names the discriminating metrics, NetworkIn-collapse decision, and the still-unattributed 23:13 spike.
- New regression guard: `tests/unit/test_gerrit_wedged_runbook_memory.py`.
- Targeted tests passed: `pytest tests/unit/test_gerrit_wedged_runbook_memory.py tests/scripts/test_observability_memory_9ea3.py tests/unit/test_alarm_actions_terraform.py tests/unit/test_alarm_window_tuning.py -q` (51 passed).
- `make lint` passed. Full `make verify PYTEST_WORKERS=2` was run twice with GIT_CONFIG_* unset; each reached >20k tests, with only unrelated/environmental existing flakes/timeouts. The failed tests passed when rerun directly.
